tw-mn-byronville-heckes-1905.st: The New Richland Star (22 Jun 1905) says the stranger, 'a man of spiritualistic proclivities', got leave from Mr. Heckes, 'who owns the Philbrook farm', to dig in the grove near the old house, long reputed haunted; after several visits and 'numerous holes about the premises' he gave up, denying that a fortune teller had sent him. Nothing found.

set.pl: Old farm house mark, SE¼ sec. 14 T105N R23W, Byron Twp (1896 Waseca atlas), a few miles NW of New Richland; the old Philbrook farm, owned by Heckes in 1905
set.tovw: Lead grade C: two 1905 accounts (local weekly and Minneapolis Journal); the $15,000 is an old settler's story, the dig found nothing
pinev: Parcel-level: 1896 Ogle Waseca County atlas house mark in SE¼ sec. 14 T105N R23W (Byron Twp); a 1938 aerial shows a farmstead and tree grove there (about 250 m).
The haunted house stood in a grove on the old Philbrook farm (Star 1905); the Heckes and Philbrook tracts in Byron Twp are not yet checked on the 1914 Waseca plat.
